items.criterion: Executing a directory group revocation closes every live connection held by the group
items.evidence: each group connection record carries a close time

items.criterion: A request whose impact grew after approval returns to pending instead of executing
items.evidence: the execute call answers impact_changed and the request reads pending

items.criterion: A user grant narrower than a group grant narrows the end user
items.evidence: the narrowed end user is refused a document write

items.criterion: The public site sits on a true black ground with hairline edged cards and a pink bloom behind the hero
items.evidence: the rendered home and pricing pages at a desktop width
